WITH returned_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id
  FROM returns
),
order_revenue AS (
  SELECT ro.order_id, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_cents) AS revenue_cents
  FROM returned_orders ro
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = ro.order_id
  GROUP BY ro.order_id
)
SELECT SUM(revenue_cents)/100.0 AS total_revenue_usd,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM order_revenue;
